content: A processor specific test algorithm is allowed to make use of har d ware macros and/or interrupts supporting the detection of data loss (like CRC, ECC) if appropriate. The implementer must describe any interrupt routine in the Basic Software Module Description and the implementation must follow the general r e quirements for interrupt handling (see SRS_BSW_00427, SRS_SPAL_12129, SRS_BSW_00325, SRS_BSW_00439, SRS_BSW_00314).
